_provenance.why: ADR 0006 section 2 requires a not-too-narrow CI assertion against the gold SQL corpus. The corpus lives in a sibling repository, so the inventory is committed here with its provenance rather than read at test time -- a gate that silently skips when a sibling checkout is absent is a gate that does not exist.

covering_sample.sql: WITH "fastest_lap_times" AS (SELECT "T1"."raceId", "T1"."fastestLapTime", (CAST(SUBSTRING("T1"."fastestLapTime" FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") - 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTRING("T1"."fastestLapTime" FROM POSITION(':' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") + 1 FOR POSITION('.' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") - POSITION(':' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") - 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) + (CAST(SUBSTRING("T1"."fastestLapTime" FROM POSITION('.' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") + 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(1000, 0)) AS "time_in_seconds" FROM "formula_1"."results" AS "T1" WHERE NOT "T1"."fastestLapTime" IS NULL) SELECT "T2"."name" FROM "formula_1"."races" AS "T2" INNER JOIN "formula_1"."circuits" AS "T3" ON "T2"."circuitId" = "T3"."circuitId" INNER JOIN "formula_1"."results" AS "T1" ON "T2"."raceId" = "T1"."raceId" INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN("fastest_lap_times"."time_in_seconds") AS "min_time_in_seconds" FROM "fastest_lap_times" INNER JOIN "formula_1"."races" AS "T2" ON "fastest_lap_times"."raceId" = "T2"."raceId" INNER JOIN "formula_1"."circuits" AS "T3" ON "T2"."circuitId" = "T3"."circuitId" WHERE "T2"."name" = 'Austrian Grand Prix') AS "T4" ON (CAST(SUBSTRING("T1"."fastestLapTime" FROM 1 FOR POSITION(':' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") - 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTRING("T1"."fastestLapTime" FROM POSITION(':' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") + 1 FOR POSITION('.' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") - POSITION(':' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") - 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) + (CAST(SUBSTRING("T1"."fastestLapTime" FROM POSITION('.' IN "T1"."fastestLapTime") + 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(1000, 0)) = "T4"."min_time_in_seconds" WHERE "T2"."name" = 'Austrian Grand Prix'

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INT) - CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("t2"."birthday" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INT) AS "age" FROM "european_football_2"."Player_Attributes" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "european_football_2"."Player" AS "t2" ON "t1"."player_api_id" = "t2"."player_api_id" WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST("t1"."date" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') >= '2013' AND TO_CHAR(CAST("t1"."date" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') <= '2015' AND "t1"."sprint_speed" >= 97
SELECT "player_name" FROM (SELECT "player_name", "height", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "height" DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rank" FROM "european_football_2"."Player") WHERE "rank" = 1
SELECT "player_name" FROM "european_football_2"."Player" WHERE CAST((CURRENT_DATE - CAST("birthday" AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 365 >= 35

SELECT "colour"."colour" AS "EyeColor", COUNT("superhero"."id") AS "Count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT("superhero"."id") DESC NULLS LAST) AS "PopularityRank" FROM "superhero"."superhero" INNER JOIN "superhero"."colour" ON "superhero"."eye_colour_id" = "colour"."id" INNER JOIN "superhero"."publisher" ON "superhero"."publisher_id" = "publisher"."id" WHERE "publisher"."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' GROUP BY "colour"."colour"

SELECT "superhero_name" FROM "superhero"."superhero" AS "T1" WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "superhero"."hero_power" AS "T2" INNER JOIN "superhero"."superpower" AS "T3" ON "T2"."power_id" = "T3"."id" WHERE "T3"."power_name" = 'Super Strength' AND "T1"."id" = "T2"."hero_id") AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "superhero"."publisher" AS "T4" WHERE "T4"."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' AND "T1"."publisher_id" = "T4"."id")

SELECT SUM(ROUND(CAST("T2"."quantityOrdered" AS DECIMAL) * CAST("T2"."priceEach" AS DECIMAL), 2)) / COUNT("T3"."orderNumber") FROM "car_retails"."products" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "car_retails"."orderdetails" AS "T2" ON "T1"."productCode" = "T2"."productCode" INNER JOIN "car_retails"."orders" AS "T3" ON "T2"."orderNumber" = "T3"."orderNumber" WHERE "T1"."productVendor" = 'Exoto Designs' AND TO_CHAR(CAST("T3"."orderDate" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2005'

SELECT LOWER("T3"."country") FROM "cars"."price" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "cars"."production" AS "T2" ON "T1"."ID" = "T2"."ID" INNER JOIN "cars"."country" AS "T3" ON "T3"."origin" = "T2"."country" WHERE ABS("T1"."price" - 44274.40748) < 0.002

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."Keyword" = 'cancer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT("T1"."Id"), (ARRAY_AGG("T2"."Name" ORDER BY "T2"."PaperId", "T2"."AuthorId"))[1], (ARRAY_AGG("T2"."Affiliation" ORDER BY "T2"."PaperId", "T2"."AuthorId"))[1] FROM "authors"."Paper" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "authors"."PaperAuthor" AS "T2" ON "T1"."Id" = "T2"."PaperId"

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM('$' FROM "T1"."total_gross"), ',', '') AS REAL) > 100000000 THEN "T1"."movie_title" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."movie_title"), 0) FROM "disney"."movies_total_gross" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "disney"."director" AS "T2" ON "T1"."movie_title" = "T2"."name" WHERE "T2"."director" = 'Gary Trousdale'

SELECT SUBSTRING("email" FROM POSITION('@' IN "email") + 1 FOR LENGTH("email") - POSITION('@' IN "email")) AS "ym" FROM "books"."customer" GROUP BY SUBSTRING("email" FROM POSITION('@' IN "email") + 1 FOR LENGTH("email") - POSITION('@' IN "email")) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
SELECT "River", STRING_AGG("Province", ',' ORDER BY "Province") FROM "mondial_geo"."geo_river" GROUP BY "River" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Country") > 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(COALESCE(CASE WHEN "T3"."gpa" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST("T3"."gpa" AS TEXT)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'null') THEN 0 WHEN CAST("T3"."gpa" AS TEXT) ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("T3"."gpa" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE 0 END, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."student_id"), 0) AS REAL) FROM "cs_semester"."RA" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "cs_semester"."prof" AS "T2" ON "T1"."prof_id" = "T2"."prof_id" INNER JOIN "cs_semester"."student" AS "T3" ON "T1"."student_id" = "T3"."student_id" WHERE "T2"."first_name" = 'Ogdon' AND "T2"."last_name" = 'Zywicki'

SELECT CAST(AVG(COALESCE(CASE WHEN "T2"."gpa" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST("T2"."gpa" AS TEXT)) IN ('', 'NULL', 'null') THEN 0 WHEN CAST("T2"."gpa" AS TEXT) ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]+([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("T2"."gpa" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS REAL), MAX("T2"."f_name"), MAX("T2"."l_name") FROM "cs_semester"."RA" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "cs_semester"."student" AS "T2" ON "T1"."student_id" = "T2"."student_id" WHERE "T1"."salary" = 'high' AND "T1"."capability" = 5 GROUP BY "T2"."student_id"

SELECT "T1"."first_name", "T1"."last_name" FROM "movie_3"."customer" AS "T1" INNER JOIN (SELECT "customer_id", COUNT(*) AS "num_days" FROM (SELECT *, CAST((CAST("days" AS DATE) - CAST(("rn" || ' days') AS INTERVAL)) AS DATE) AS "results" FROM (SELECT "customer_id", "days", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "customer_id" ORDER BY "days") AS "rn" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "customer_id", DATE("rental_date") AS "days" FROM "movie_3"."rental")) AS "sub1") AS "sub2" GROUP BY "customer_id", "results" HAVING COUNT(*) = 7) AS "A" ON "T1"."customer_id" = "A"."customer_id"
